name: Ciales (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Seven unequal vertical stripes of yellow, red, yellow, purple, yellow, red and yellow, an abstract composition repeating the colours of the arms.
history: Ciales is a town and municipality in the Cordillera Central of Puerto Rico. The flag, coat of arms and seal were adopted for the 150th anniversary of the town's foundation by Resolution No. 13 of the 1969–1970 series, sanctioned by Mayor Ismael Nazario in 1970.
